compatibility_warnings.consumer_compatibility: UNVERIFIED; consumer must explicitly accept null and per-collider USD evidence
compatibility_warnings.reason: No faithful legacy hull-enum summary: zero colliders, unavailable/fallback approximation, non-mesh shape, SDF, mixed set, or unexpanded convexDecomposition cooking request.

contract.bounds: meters; world visual mesh-vertex/analytic-primitive AABB; native Z-up mapped to Y-up (x,z,-y); extents ignored
contract.center_of_mass: body-local USD axes, meters; NOT remapped to Y-up world; no world transform baked in
contract.colliders: nearest RigidBodyAPI ancestor owns collider; all paths/types/approximations/material binding and authored physics attributes retained; not a cooked collision mesh export
contract.consumer_compatibility: UNVERIFIED: nulls, extensions, raw Infinity strings and field semantics require consumer contract validation
contract.density: kg/m^3 if finite positive authored; null when absent or sentinel. No material/volume inference
contract.geometry_selection: visible default/render-purpose Gprims incl. dual-purpose rendered meshes carrying CollisionAPI; guide/proxy/invisible geometry (guide collision hulls, guide grasp curves) excluded
contract.inertia: diagonal principal moments about COM in kg*m^2, body-local mass frame, NOT world inertia tensor
contract.inertia_axes: quaternion [w,x,y,z] principal mass axes relative to body-local USD frame, NOT Y-up transformed
contract.joint_axis: USD X/Y/Z token in the JOINT-local frame; localRot0/localRot1 orient it relative to respective body frame, no Y-up remapping
contract.joint_frames: local_position raw USD length units; local_rotation_wxyz unit quaternion; world_matrix_stage_units row-vector matrix local joint * body world incl authored scale; world_position_m in native Z-up
contract.joint_limits: motion_limits degrees for revolute, meters for prismatic; raw usd_attributes/drives/limits preserve native USD units
contract.legacy_collider_type: convex_hull only for one Mesh+MeshCollisionAPI collider with authored convexHull; convex_decomposition only for multiple such hull collider prims of one body (representation, not generation history). SDF/mixed/fallback/unavailable/unexpanded convexDecomposition -> null plus compatibility warning. Exact USD approximation and its status remain per collider; no cooked-hull or consumer validation claimed
contract.mass: kg, exact USD float expanded to Python double times independently verified kilogramsPerUnit; no decimal rounding
contract.mesh_limit: authored point hull bounds, not renderer subdivision/displacement/skinning evaluated bounds. Unsupported visible Gprims fail closed
contract.nonfinite: Only raw schema/physics fields may use +Infinity/-Infinity/NaN strings; canonical missing COM/inertia/etc are null
contract.null: unavailable or ambiguous, never zero/identity/default invented; per-field reasons in separate migration_report.json
contract.part_origin_world: meters in same legacy Y-up world frame as bounds
contract.qa: metadata-only static migration, NOT full QA READY
contract.raw_physics_units: linear distances: stage length; mass: stage mass; time: seconds; angular limits/targets: degrees; angular velocity: degrees/sec. Forces, torques, stiffness, damping, acceleration and armature retain USD API units (including degree-based angular drive conventions); no runtime conversion claimed
contract.sample: Usd.TimeCode.Default; static authored rest pose only, no simulation/deformation evaluation
contract.schema: locally defined nullable legacy structure; not a versioned downstream consumer contract
contract.summary_fields: part friction/offset summaries only when every collider agrees with a finite authored value; detailed per-collider bindings preserved

units.mass_unit_validation: UsdPhysics.GetStageKilogramsPerUnit: registered USD fallback, not inferred from another asset
